Hi Elena,

Great to meet you over the call earlier. Per our discussion, attached is our vendor orientation kit to get Redwood set up in Veridian's procurement system. The packet includes:

- Redwood_New-Vendor_Kit_2026.pdf (overview, contact list, PO process)
- Supplier_Code_of_Conduct.pdf (signed copy, company policy highlights)
- Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf (SOC 2 scope summary and contact for security questions)

Action items for Veridian to complete the vendor setup:
1) Return the completed Veridian vendor intake form (I attached a blank copy to the Drive link below).
2) Confirm preferred PO contact and billing email for invoices.
3) If required, we can provide a completed W-9 (attached on request) and bank details for ACH.
4) Let us know any insurance certificate requirements and we will route to our operations team.

I copied Laura (Finance) and Marcus (Customer Success) for any questions about tax/banking and onboarding timelines. If it helps, Laura can send an official W-9 and a pre-filled vendor form to speed things up.

Drive with intake form & short checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxxRedwood/Procurement-Onboarding
DocuSign (MSA if needed): https://docusign.com/2a1b2c3d-redwood-msa

Target next step: if you can return the intake form and confirm billing contact by end of week we can accept the first PO next week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Jonas Weber

Redwood Inference

Hi Jonas — thanks for sending this. Quick questions so we can move forward: 

- Can you provide Redwood's Tax ID (EIN) and a completed W-9? Our procurement system requires the W-9 to be uploaded before we create the vendor record.
- Please confirm the legal entity name and the remit-to address for invoices.
- Do you have a preferred vendor code or will we assign one?
- Insurance: we require a certificate of insurance with general liability and cyber liability limits. If you already have one, please share it or let me know who to coordinate with.

I attached our vendor intake form (blank) for completion. Once we receive the W-9 and intake form we can create a vendor ID and issue the first PO. Let me know if you need a PO template or special instructions for invoice submission.

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Senior Procurement Manager
Veridian Health
elena@veridianhealth.com | +1 (503) 777-3400

Attachment: Veridian_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (application/pdf)
